title: The category of adequate modules is abelian and its inclusion is exact
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma records four properties of the category Adeq(O) of adequate modules on (Sch/S)_tau: it is abelian, the functor to all O-modules is exact, adequacy of the middle term of a short exact sequence follows from adequacy of the outer two, and the category has colimits preserved by the inclusion (statement lines 2025-2043). The proof treats them in turn: for (1) and (2) it shows that the kernel and cokernel of an adequate map are adequate, the kernel by working with the induced map of functors and the cokernel by identifying it as the sheafification of the presheaf cokernel; for (3) it uses the vanishing of H^1 on affines to see that the sequence of associated functors is exact and applies the extension lemma; and (4) is handled with the colimit lemma (proof lines 2045-2099). The level is H3: four statements, each with its own reduction and each reduction displayed with the point where sheafification or H^1-vanishing enters.
